items.title: UK PADEL opens at Willen Lake on 17 October — Milton Keynes gets six more courts
items.summary: Four covered all-weather courts and two open-air courts, with daily social mix-in sessions.

items.title: Scottish Open Padel Championships streamed live on BBC iPlayer
items.summary: Finals from the inaugural Glasgow event went out on BBC iPlayer — a step up in mainstream visibility for UK padel.

items.title: Structuring padel leases for growth: five key points for operators
items.summary: Legal briefing on how operators should structure leases when expanding.

items.title: The Padel Club raises £3m to triple its footprint
items.summary: Wilmslow-founded operator takes NPIF II / PXN backing to fund eight new sites (Chester, Liverpool, Knutsford, Sheffield, Cardiff, Brighton, Sutton Coldfield), taking it to 85 courts. Reports roughly 100% revenue growth in H1 2026.

items.title: The Bath curse is broken — but padel “must do more to change the narrative”
items.summary: Smash Padel's Rupert Taylor on the Bath opening and the perception problem the industry still has.

items.title: Empower Padel and LTA launch programme to boost women's padel
items.summary: Joint participation programme targeting women and girls.

items.title: Padel Social Club secures £5.5m to open three new London venues
items.summary: Clark Group, Active Partners and Stormzy back 17 new courts at Paddington, Kentish Town and The O2. Its Earls Court site runs above 95% peak-time occupancy across 30,000+ players.
